about.description:
cdxgen is the official OWASP CycloneDX generator: it creates SBOMs
(software), CBOMs (cryptography), OBOMs (operations), and ML-BOMs for
source repositories, container images, and binaries across 20+
languages and package-manager ecosystems, emitting standards-compliant
CycloneDX. Ships the full CLI family: cdxgen, cdx-audit, cdx-convert,
cdx-validate, cdx-verify, cdx-sign, cdxi (REPL), evinse, hbom, obom,
cbom, aibom, saasbom, spdxgen, tracebom.
about.summary: Creates CycloneDX Bill of Materials (BOM) for projects and containers in 20+ languages and package managers

cdxgen is the official OWASP CycloneDX generator: it creates SBOMs
(software), CBOMs (cryptography), OBOMs (operations), and ML-BOMs for
source repositories, container images, and binaries across 20+
languages and package-manager ecosystems, emitting standards-compliant
CycloneDX. Ships the full CLI family: cdxgen, cdx-audit, cdx-convert,
cdx-validate, cdx-verify, cdx-sign, cdxi (REPL), evinse, hbom, obom,

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "12.7.1"
  # Keep in sync with cdxgen's optionalDependencies.
  atom_parsetools_version: "1.2.2"

package:
  name: cdxgen
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://registry.npmjs.org/@cyclonedx/cdxgen/-/cdxgen-${{ version }}.tgz
  sha256: 52061c32e7795bfe6f1133944e408af76c9d3e3a4a8fa6dc59bb0015cf440ef3

build:
  number: 0
  # Per-arch (NOT noarch), following the openspec pattern: each
  # platform's npm global install lays down native shims for all 16 bin
  # entries (symlinks on unix, .cmd on win), which a single noarch
  # artifact cannot provide. https://github.com/conda-forge/openspec-feedstock/blob/main/recipe/recipe.yaml
  dynamic_linking:
    binary_relocation: false
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - export npm_config_prefix="${PREFIX}"
        - pnpm install --ignore-scripts --prod
        - npm pack --ignore-scripts
        - npm install -g ./cyclonedx-cdxgen-${{ version }}.tgz
        - rm -rf "${PREFIX}"/lib/node_modules/@cyclonedx/cdxgen/node_modules/@cdxgen/cdxgen-plugins-bin*
        - pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --output-file=third-party-licenses.txt
      else:
        - call npm config set prefix "%PREFIX%"
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call pnpm install --ignore-scripts --prod
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call npm pack --ignore-scripts
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call npm install --userconfig nonexistentrc -g cyclonedx-cdxgen-${{ version }}.tgz
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        # Install parser tools at the top level to shorten their bundled Ruby
        # paths before rattler-build extracts the package into its test cache.
        - call npm install --userconfig nonexistentrc --prefix "%PREFIX%" -g @appthreat/atom-parsetools@${{ atom_parsetools_version }}
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - if exist "%PREFIX%\node_modules\@cyclonedx\cdxgen\node_modules\@appthreat\atom-parsetools" rmdir /s /q "%PREFIX%\node_modules\@cyclonedx\cdxgen\node_modules\@appthreat\atom-parsetools"
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        # Use npm's new top-level shims; remove shims pointing to the old copy.
        - for %%F in (astgen astgen.cmd astgen.ps1 rbastgen rbastgen.cmd rbastgen.ps1 scalasem scalasem.cmd scalasem.ps1 phpastgen phpastgen.cmd phpastgen.ps1) do if exist "%PREFIX%\node_modules\@cyclonedx\cdxgen\node_modules\.bin\%%F" del /q "%PREFIX%\node_modules\@cyclonedx\cdxgen\node_modules\.bin\%%F"
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - for /d %%D in ("%PREFIX%\node_modules\@cyclonedx\cdxgen\node_modules\@cdxgen\cdxgen-plugins-bin*") do rmdir /s /q "%%D"
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --output-file=third-party-licenses.txt
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1

requirements:
  build:
    - pnpm
    - pnpm-licenses
  host:
    - nodejs >=20,<26
  run:
    - nodejs >=20,<26

tests:
  - script:
      - if: unix
        then:
          - cdxgen --version
          - cdxgen --help
          - cdx-validate --help
        else:
          - call cdxgen --version
          - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
          - call cdxgen --help
          - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
          - call cdx-validate --help
          - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
          - call astgen --help
          - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
          - if not exist "%PREFIX%\node_modules\@appthreat\atom-parsetools\package.json" exit 1
          - if exist "%PREFIX%\node_modules\@cyclonedx\cdxgen\node_modules\@appthreat\atom-parsetools" exit 1
  - if: unix
    then:
      script:
        - test -f "${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules/@cyclonedx/cdxgen/package.json"
        - if ls -d "${PREFIX}"/lib/node_modules/@cyclonedx/cdxgen/node_modules/@cdxgen/cdxgen-plugins-bin* >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; fi

  description: |
    cdxgen is the official OWASP CycloneDX generator: it creates SBOMs
    (software), CBOMs (cryptography), OBOMs (operations), and ML-BOMs for
    source repositories, container images, and binaries across 20+
    languages and package-manager ecosystems, emitting standards-compliant
    CycloneDX. Ships the full CLI family: cdxgen, cdx-audit, cdx-convert,
    cdx-validate, cdx-verify, cdx-sign, cdxi (REPL), evinse, hbom, obom,
    cbom, aibom, saasbom, spdxgen, tracebom.
  homepage: https://cyclonedx.github.io/cdxgen/
  repository: https://github.com/cdxgen/cdxgen
  documentation: https://cyclonedx.github.io/cdxgen/
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - third-party-licenses.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
